title: XSS protection on hits breaks searchForFacetValues
body:
When using both `escapeHits` on the hits widget and `searchForFacetValues` on a refinementList, the highlighted results of the SFFV will use the pre and post highlight tags of the hits.

![2017-10-17 15 08 14](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/393765/31666615-22690f4e-b34d-11e7-99ef-4d2dde8d2b9e.gif)

Proposed solution:

* make sure that the connectRefinementList implementations receives properly cleaned results
* deprecate escapeHits at the widget level and move it to an instantsearch option

@iam4x what do you think?
